In each case, HoliGRALE is able to accurately reconstruct observed magnifications and time delays. In its predictions, HoliGRALE is found to be more precise than GRALE. We particularly highlight the predicted time delay for the next arriving image of SN Requiem to be $4346.61^{+490.27}_{-818.36}$ days ($\approx$ April 2026 -- October 2029), consistent with previous work, albeit with less precision. In Abell S1063, we report the reconstruction of a main dark matter halo core radius of $89.9\pm33.2$ kpc, in excellent agreement with past work and useful in testing theories of dark matter. Our results emphasize the expected error budget of HoliGRALE, which should be mentioned and scrutinized in future applications of HoliGRALE for other lens systems.

title: KDG 162: A Nearby Isolated Star-forming Dwarf Galaxy
background_knowledge: 孤立矮星系（isolated dwarf galaxies）是研究星系本征演化机制的理想天然实验室。在密集的星系群或星系团环境中，矮星系往往会受到强烈的环境效应（如潮汐剥离、冲压剥离等）干扰，从而导致气体损失和恒星形成活动熄灭；相比之下，处于低密度场环境中的孤立矮星系则能较好地保留其本征演化足迹，直接反映内部超新星反馈、冷气体吸积等物理过程。在邻近宇宙（Local Universe）研究中，利用高空间分辨率观测解析单个恒星，并借助红巨星支顶端（Tip of the Red Giant Branch, TRGB）作为标准烛光，是精确测定星系距离的核心方法。准确的距离基准不仅直接决定了星系的绝对光度、恒星质量以及气体质量等物理参数的估算，也是厘清其所处动力学环境及吸积历史的前提。
contribution: 本研究利用哈勃空间望远镜（HST）对邻近低质量矮星系 KDG 162 进行了高分辨率成像，成功解析至红巨星支顶端以下 3 个星等的单颗恒星。研究基于 TRGB 测定出该星系的新距离为 **$D = 3.48 \pm 0.12\text{ Mpc}$**（高于先前的测量值），并确认其在动力学上相对孤立，正处于 **首次落入 M81 星系群边缘** 的轨道阶段。通过解析恒星群重构其近期的恒星形成历史，发现其在 **过去约 $500\text{ Myr}$ 间仅经历过温和的恒星形成活动**；此外，测得其现今的 **恒星质量约为中性氢（H I）气体质量的 2 倍**，修正了此前对其气体极其富集程度的认知，为邻近宇宙中孤立低质量矮星系的演化提供了重要的观测样本与物理约束。
summary: The nearby dwarf galaxy KDG 162 (also known as KK 153) has recently attracted attention as a potentially gas-rich, isolated, and low-mass dwarf galaxy. However, many of these characterizations depend on the true distance to KDG 162. Here we present new Hubble Space Telescope (HST) imaging that resolves individual stars down to 3 magnitudes below the tip of the red giant branch. Using this HST imaging, we determine a distance to KDG 162 of D = 3.48 $\pm$ 0.12 Mpc, somewhat higher than previous determinations. We find KDG 162 to be relatively isolated and lying at the edge of first infall onto the M81 group. We use its stellar content to measure its recent star formation history and find that only a modest amount of star formation can be attributed to within the last $\sim$500 Myr. The present-day stellar mass outweighs the H I mass by a factor of 2$\times$. The properties of KDG 162 add to an increasingly detailed picture of nearby and isolated low-mass galaxies. In the future, deeper observations would allow for reaching more age-sensitive populations, enabling the recovery of its star-formation history back to ancient times.

title: Full-Shape Analysis of the Redshift-Space Galaxy Trispectrum in the EFTofLSS
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构（Large-Scale Structure, LSS）是检验现代宇宙学模型和探索新物理的关键前沿。在星系巡天中，密度场的统计性质通常通过傅里叶空间中的各阶 $N$ 点关联函数（功率谱、双谱、三谱等）进行量化。随着密度场经历非线性引力塌缩，两点统计量（功率谱）无法捕捉所有的宇宙学信息，而更高阶统计量（如三谱，即四点关联函数）能够有效打破参数简并度并提取非高斯特征。大尺度结构有效场论（Effective Field Theory of Large-Scale Structure, EFTofLSS）是近年来发展起来的系统性微扰理论框架，它通过引入重整化反项，严谨地考虑了小尺度非线性物理对大尺度准线性范围的影响，并统一处理了红移空间畸变（如手指效应 Fingers-of-God）、星系偏置与随机项等效应，成为了当前开展全形态（Full-Shape）宇宙学参数推断的核心工具。
contribution: 本研究首次构建并实现了**基于 EFTofLSS 框架的红移空间星系三谱树图能级理论模型**，系统纳入了星系偏置、随机项、红外重求和（IR resummation）、手指效应（FoG）反项、Alcock-Paczynski 效应、分箱效应及协方差。作者利用有效体积达 $V = 200\,h^{-3}\text{Gpc}^3$ 的 25 套 AbacusSummit $N$ 体模拟暗物质晕数据，联合单圈功率谱与树图能级双谱进行了宇宙学推断与精度验证，精确确立了实空间与红移空间的最大截断尺度。研究发现，在类 DESI 巡天体积下，引入星系三谱可使冷暗物质密度 **$\omega_{\rm cdm}$ 等关键参数的约束精度提升高达 15%**；得益于对 FoG 效应的改进处理，分析的有效截断尺度可进一步延展至 **$k_{\max} = 0.12\,h\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$**。该工作为未来利用三维大尺度结构高阶统计量探测原初非高斯性及新物理开辟了全新路径。
summary: The effective field theory of large-scale structure (EFTofLSS) program for spectroscopic galaxy surveys has been remarkably successful for cosmological inference from the galaxy power spectrum and bispectrum. However, a full-shape cosmological analysis including the galaxy trispectrum has not yet been performed. In this work, we develop the tree-level EFTofLSS model of the galaxy trispectrum, including all relevant ingredients: galaxy bias, stochasticity, infrared resummation, Fingers-of-God (FoG) counterterms, Alcock-Paczynski distortions, binning effects, and covariance. We validate the model by performing cosmological inference using the one-loop galaxy power spectrum, tree-level bispectrum, and tree-level trispectrum measured from dark-matter halos in 25 AbacusSummit $N$-body simulations, whose large effective volume ($V=200h^{-3}\text{Gpc}^3$) allows us to test the precision of our model and determine scale cuts in both real-space and redshift-space. We also study the cosmological information content of the galaxy trispectrum in a DESI-like volume, finding that its inclusion can improve constraints e.g., on $ω_{\rm cdm}$ by up to $15\%$. We further find that the maximum scale cut can be extended to $k_{\max}=0.12h\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ depending on the tracer, thanks to our improved treatment of FoG effects. This provides a path towards using the three-dimensional large-scale structure to constrain new-physics scenarios with distinctive signatures in the trispectrum, in particular primordial non-Gaussianity.

title: MUSE-ALMA Haloes XV: Cold molecular, ionised, and stellar kinematics of HI-rich galaxies at z $\sim$ 0.5
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化的标准物理图像中，气体通过吸积、冷却并在暗物质晕中心角动量守恒下沉降，进而形成旋转支撑的气体与恒星盘。在邻近宇宙（$z \sim 0$），成熟的盘星系普遍处于“动力学冷”的状态，表现出较低的内禀速度弥散 $\sigma$ 以及较高的旋转支撑比 $v/\sigma$；而在宇宙早期（$z > 1$），盘星系受剧烈气体吸积、原初并合以及强烈的恒星形成反馈等因素驱动，展现出极高的湍流与动力学弥散。红移 $z \sim 0.5$ 对应着宇宙恒星形成活动逐渐回落、“盘沉降”（disk settling）以及重子物质与暗物质质量分配调整的关键过渡阶段。理解该时期驱动盘湍流的主导机制（引力不稳定性还是恒星反馈），需要通过毫米波干涉仪（观测冷分子气体）与光学积分视场光谱仪（观测暖电离气体和恒星）对多组分相态开展空间分辨的联合运动学建模，但这在中红移巡天中仍极为稀缺。
contribution: 本研究利用 MUSE-ALMA Haloes 巡天数据，结合 ALMA 的 CO(2-1) 观测、MUSE 的暖电离气体（$\text{H}\beta$）及恒星吸收线数据与 HST 形态学，对 $0.43 < z < 0.83$ 范围内通过 $\text{H}\ \text{I}$ 吸收线选样的 6 个大质量星系（$\log(M_\star/M_\odot) = 10.1 - 11.8$）展开了多示踪剂的空间分辨运动学分析。核心成果包括：通过形态与运动学综合判据确认其中 **4 个星系为旋转盘星系**；这些盘的气体速度弥散显著高于近邻同类天体，与 $z \sim 0$ 至 $z > 1$ 的平滑演化内插趋势一致；运动学建模支持这些系统处于**临界稳定的气态盘**，其湍流由**引力不稳定性与恒星反馈共同驱动**；初步观测证据表明暖电离相在动力学上比冷分子相更“热”（**$\sigma_{0, \text{H}\beta} \sim 1.7 \times \sigma_{0, \text{CO}}$**）；测得星系尺度的平均暗物质质量占比为 **$\langle f_{\text{DM}} \rangle = 0.42 \pm 0.14$**。该工作成功验证了利用自洽多波段数据研究中红移盘沉降物理过程的有效性。
summary: Spatially resolved galaxy kinematics are well studied at z $\sim$ 0 and z > 1, revealing that disks are common out to z $\sim3-6$, albeit with higher velocity dispersions. z $\sim$ 0.5 marks a key transition in the drivers of disk turbulence and baryonic-dark matter mass budgets, yet multi-tracer resolved kinematic studies remain rare beyond the local Universe. We exploit a unique dataset combining ALMA CO observations with MUSE ionised gas and stellar continuum data to study the resolved kinematics of six galaxies at 0.43 < z < 0.83, part of the MUSE-ALMA Haloes program, selected via their association with H I absorption systems and spanning stellar masses from log$(M_\star/M_\odot) = 10.1 - 11.8$. Combining new ALMA/CO data with existing MUSE H$β$ kinematics and HST morphologies, we classify galaxies using morpho-kinematic criteria. For rotating disks, we jointly model H$β$ and CO(2-1) kinematics with DYSMALPY and compare results to theoretical predictions for pressure support, while pPXF is used to fit stellar absorption features. Four of the six galaxies are classified as disks, with two having known group members. These disks show elevated gas velocity dispersions relative to z $\sim$ 0 disks, consistent with interpolated trends between z $\sim$ 0 and z > 1. The results support marginally stable gaseous disks where gravitational instability still contributes alongside stellar feedback, with tentative evidence for a dynamically hotter warm ionised phase relative to cold gas ($σ_{0, Hβ} \sim 1.7 \times σ_{0, CO}$). We derive an average dark matter fraction $\langle f_{DM} \rangle = 0.42\pm0.14$, consistent with observations at similar redshifts, stellar masses, and surface densities. This work demonstrates the value of self-consistent, multi-wavelength analyses for probing disk settling physics in a relatively unexplored redshift range.

title: Modeling the nanohertz gravitational wave background with the t-process: Improved frequentist analysis of gravitational-wave power
background_knowledge: 纳赫兹引力波背景（Nanohertz Gravitational Wave Background, GWB）通常被认为主要源于宇宙演化历史中星系并合所形成的超大质量双黑洞系统（Supermassive Black Hole Binaries, SMBHBs）发出的引力波非相干叠加。脉冲星测时阵列（Pulsar Timing Array, PTA）通过长期精确监测银河系内毫秒脉冲星信号的到达时间扰动，用于搜寻该引力波背景及其标志性的赫林斯-唐斯（Hellings-Downs）空间相关性。在理想化、连续且数量无限的双黑洞群体假设下，引力波背景的功率谱密度（Power Spectral Density, PSD）通常呈现光滑的幂律形式。然而在真实宇宙中，高频段的双黑洞数量有限，且少数邻近或大质量的优势源可能会主导局部频段的辐射，导致实际的功率谱显著偏离简单的平滑幂律。传统 PTA 数据分析通常在过于僵硬的全局幂律模型与参数自由度过高、易受噪声干扰的自由谱（free spectrum）模型之间进行权衡。
contribution: 本研究提出并评估了一种基于 **$t$-process（$t$ 过程）** 的新型引力波谱密度建模方法。该模型以幂律谱作为底层先验分布，同时允许各个离散频率通道在此基础上自由偏离。基于 $100$ 次逼真的超大质量双黑洞群体模拟数据，作者使用贝叶斯与频率学派方法对比了 $t$-process、纯幂律及自由谱模型的表现：发现 **$t$-process 模型给出的 PSD 测量精度最高**，其不确定度相比幂律模型与自由谱模型分别**缩窄了 $43\%$ 和 $26\%$**；在前 $9$ 个频率通道中，该模型计算出的各向同性及各向异性信噪比（SNR）中位数相比幂律提升约 **$46\%$**、相比自由谱提升约 **$65\%$**；此外，在各向异性显着性指标（$p < 0.01$）的频段内，**$t$-process 成功在天图角分辨率内定位最强单个双黑洞源的概率达到 $14.3\%$**，显著优于幂律模型的 $10\%$ 与自由谱模型的 $6.2\%$。
summary: Pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations have recently reported evidence for a gravitational wave background (GWB) signal in the nanohertz band, which most likely originates from the incoherent superposition of GWs emitted by a population of supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). Since the number of binaries emitting in each frequency bin is finite, and since individual loud sources can dominate the GWB, the power spectral density (PSD) of the background is expected to deviate significantly from the smooth power law that describes an idealized population. PTA searches usually describe the PSD either with a power law or with a free spectrum model, which fits the PSD in each frequency bin as a free parameter. In this paper, we explore the t-process as a third model; it assumes a power law as the underlying spectrum but leaves each frequency bin free to deviate from it. We compare the performance of these three models on simulated datasets, injecting $100$ realizations of a realistic SMBHB population, to evaluate how well each model recovers a complex PSD. Using Bayesian and frequentist tools, we find that the t-process model gives the most precise PSD results, with uncertainties $43\%$ and $26\%$ narrower than those obtained with the power law and the free spectrum, respectively, while the improvement in accuracy is smaller. Moreover, using the t-process model, we compute isotropic and anisotropic signal-to-noise ratios with median gains of about $46\%$ over the power law and $65\%$ over the free spectrum in the first nine frequency bins. The t-process also returns lower anisotropy p-values and among the frequency bins with $p<0.01$, it allows to localize the loudest binary within the angular resolution of the sky maps in $14.3\%$ of the cases, compared to the $10\%$ for the power law and the $6.2\%$ for the free spectrum.

title: The Impact of Galaxy Catalogue Completeness with GLADE+ on Dark Siren Cosmology: A Line-of-Sight Prior Analysis of GWTC-3 Events
background_knowledge: 引力波源通常被称为“标准汽笛”（Standard Sirens），因为通过引力波波形分析可以直接独立测量并合事件的光度距离，而无需依赖传统天文观测中的宇宙距离阶梯。然而，宇宙学参数（如哈勃常数 $H_0$）的测定同时需要源的天体物理红移。对于缺乏明亮电磁对应体的并合事件（如双黑洞并合），这类事件被称为“暗汽笛”（Dark Sirens）。暗汽笛宇宙学采用统计推断方法，将引力波事件的三维定位体积与全天星系巡天星表（如 GLADE+）进行交叉比对，利用视向方向上潜在宿主星系的红移分布来统计约束宇宙学参数。在这一过程中，星系巡天星表的星等完备度（Completeness）与深度构成了主要的系统误差来源，因此量化更暗星系的加入对视向先验分布及宇宙学推断的影响，是高精度引力波宇宙学的关键前沿课题。
contribution: 本研究基于 GLADE+ 星系星表，系统分析了视星等截断对第三代引力波瞬态源星表（GWTC-3）中 46 个并合事件（包含 42 个双黑洞、3 个中子星-黑洞并合以及双中子星事件 GW190425）暗汽笛宇宙学推断的影响。研究发现，**引入更暗弱星系对几乎所有事件的联合宇宙学分析未产生显著影响**，其物理原因在于较暗星系的红移分布与绝大多数距离较远的引力波事件在视向红移空间上并不重叠。然而，**对于个别定位精度极高且距离较近的事件（特别是 GW190814），纳入暗弱星系则产生了显著影响**，因为其距离转化的红移范围与暗星系分布存在实质性重合。通过定量分析视向先验的信息增益，该研究表明**事件的空间定位精度与星表巡天深度共同决定了星表完备度的敏感性**，并预示随着未来更深巡天星表的建立，暗弱星系将在多事件联合宇宙学参数估计中发挥更加重要的作用。
summary: Cosmological parameters can be estimated from dark sirens, gravitational waves events without electromagnetic counterpart, by using inference methods which estimate statistically the source redshift from galaxy catalogs. We study the effects of applying different apparent magnitude cuts to the GLADE+ catalog, analyzing events from the third LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA gravitational wave transient catalog (GWTC-3), consisting of 42 binary black holes, 3 neutron star black hole systems and the event GW190425 associated to a binary neutron star coalescence. We find that the inclusion of fainter galaxies has no significant effects on the joint analysis of almost all the events, while for some single well localized event, the effects can be more important, in particular for the event GW190814. To understand why inclusion of fainter galaxies in general has negligible impact on the estimation of cosmological parameters, we compare the redshift of the events with the redshift distribution of dimmer galaxies, and find that most of them are not located in redshift proximity of the events, explaining the limited impact of their inclusion. The event, GW190814 is an exception, as its distance localization, converted into redshift, overlaps with fainter galaxies, unlike what happens for other events, which are farther away. These results show the importance of event localization and catalog depth in determining the impact of catalog completeness on cosmological parameters estimation. To check quantitatively what is the information gained by adding fainter galaxies we have analyzed its impact on the line of sight prior calculation. Based on the results for GW190814 we expect that fainter galaxies will play a more significant role in the estimation of cosmological parameters also for the joint analysis of multiple events, when deeper catalogs will be available.

title: Assessment of sky brightness in central Portugal: the Dark Sky destination "Aldeias do Xisto" case study
background_knowledge: 夜空背景亮度（Night Sky Brightness, NSB）与夜间人工光（Artificial Light At Night, ALAN）是评估天文观测台址质量及暗夜生态保护的关键指标。随着现代城市化进程的加速，人造灯光在大气中的散射形成了显著的人造天光背景（skyglow），严重削弱了地面光学望远镜探测暗弱天体的能力，并压缩了优质暗夜资源的分布范围。在天文台址选址与暗夜保护区评估中，现代研究范式已从单一的地面点位测量，转向结合天基卫星遥感（如 Suomi-NPP 卫星搭载的 VIIRS 仪器）、气象云覆盖反演和地理信息系统（GIS）空间分析的多维综合评估。通过卫星遥感大尺度反演结合地基便携式测光仪（如 SQM）的原位定标，科研人员能够在控制时间和经济成本的前提下，高精度量化区域夜空暗度与晴夜率，这不仅服务于专业天文观测台站的建设，也为“星光保护区”评定和天文旅游资源的合理开发提供了关键科学依据。
contribution: 本研究结合卫星遥感、开放空间数据与地面实测，对葡萄牙中部山区的片岩村地区（Aldeias do Xisto，覆盖面积 $1624\text{ km}^2$）在 2012–2017 年间的暗夜亮度和气象条件进行了系统评估。研究利用 Suomi-NPP 卫星上的 VIIRS 仪器获取长期夜间人工光数据，并结合 MODIS/AQUA 卫星的云覆盖率与地形高程在 GIS 环境中进行了综合空间分析。地基 SQM 测光仪的天顶观测验证了卫星衍生数据的可靠性，测量显示该区域最暗区域的夜空亮度达到 **$21.4\text{ mag/arcsec}^2$**。该工作建立了一套**低成本、高精度的暗夜评估方案**，为发展中国家及欠发达地区在论证天文台址和开发天文旅游提供了可推广的范式，并成功支持该地区于 2018 年获得**“暗夜星光旅游胜地”（Dark Sky Starlight Tourist Destination）的国际认证**。
summary: A combination of remote sensing techniques, open space data and field testing was developed to derive astronomical and meteorological parameters and assess Dark Sky brightness of the hitherto unstudied Schist Villages region in the mountainous Interior Center of Portugal. This study covered the period 2012-2017 and established the methodology for regular light pollution and sky brightness studies in the region using satellite imagery to reduce cost and time and increase accuracy of the final analysis. Long-term Artificial Light At Night (ALAN) data from VIIRS instrument aboard the Suomi-NPP satellite along with cloud cover inferred from MODUS/AQUA satellite data and orographic data, were analyzed in a Geographical Information Systems (GIS) environment. The derived ALAN values were consistent with a preliminary site survey selection, confirming the accuracy of the identified dark sky spots in the region. The analyzed region area spans 1624 Km$^2$ and the darkest site within it showed a sky brightness of 21.4 mag/arcsec$^2$. Ground-based SQM photometer observations of the Night Sky Brightness (NSB) at the zenith validated the satellite derived ALAN data. The devised field testing is itself a low cost solution that can be used by teams in developing countries to easily assess dark sky potential prior to the development of local observatories and astro-tourism activities. This study supported the initial certification of this region as a Dark Sky Starlight Tourist Destination since 2018, an important milestone for dark sky protection in central Portugal.

title: SAGE26 Paper I: Modelling the baryon cycle from cosmic dawn to the present day
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型（$\Lambda$CDM）下，暗物质晕通过引力塌缩形成骨架，重子气体随后落入暗物质晕的引力势阱中，通过辐射冷却、凝聚并触发恒星形成。重子在星系内部、星系周介质（CGM）以及晕际空间之间的循环过程（包括冷气体吸积、恒星与超新星反馈、活动星系核反馈以及气体再循环）被称为“重子循环”，它是调控星系生长与演化的核心物理机制。为了在大尺度宇宙体积内模拟这一复杂系统，半解析星系演化模型（SAM）通过在暗物质晕合并树上耦合解析物理处方，兼具了极高的计算效率与灵活的物理参数化能力。近年来，詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）在极高红移（宇宙黎明时期）发现了超乎传统理论预期的大质量亮星系，这对现有的气体吸积效率与恒星反馈机制提出了新的挑战，亟需新一代半解析模型进行物理自洽的修正与整合。
contribution: 本研究提出了 **SAGE26**，对半解析星系演化模型（SAGE）进行了系统性升级，从宇宙黎明到现代宇宙全面重构了重子循环处方。该模型融合了五项关键改进：(1) 区分星系周介质与热晕气体物理机制，利用特征晕激波质量区分低质量晕的自由落体吸积与高质晕的流体静力学冷却；(2) 引入以分子氢为主导的恒星形成模型；(3) 采纳依赖于速度和红移的超新星反馈机制；(4) 追踪星系核球半径随时间的演化；(5) 引入**无反馈暴发（feedback-free burst）星系机制**。研究表明，无反馈暴发机制**成功解释了 JWST 观测到的极高红移大质量星系的高丰度现象**，且改进后的星系周介质框架显著提升了全质量范围内的重子处理精度。SAGE26 在保持极高计算效率与开源可复现性的同时，**成功重现了横跨整个宇宙演化史的恒星质量函数与宇宙恒星形成率密度**等关键观测约束。
summary: We present SAGE26, a comprehensive update to the Semi-Analytic Galaxy Evolution (SAGE) model. SAGE26 integrates five observationally motivated improvements: (1) distinct circumgalactic medium and hot-halo gas physics, (2) molecular hydrogen for star formation, (3) velocity- and redshift-dependent supernova feedback, (4) bulge radii tracking through time, and (5) feedback-free burst galaxies. Each improvement works to regulate galaxy formation from cosmic dawn to the present. Most significantly, the addition of feedback-free burst galaxies provides a pathway to produce high-redshift massive galaxies at the abundances observed by the James Webb Space Telescope. Furthermore, the new circumgalactic medium framework improves the treatment of baryons by distinguishing between free-fall-limited inflow in low-mass haloes and hydrostatic cooling in massive groups and clusters using a characteristic halo shock mass. SAGE26 reproduces key observational constraints across cosmic time, including the stellar mass function and cosmic star formation rate density, while retaining the computational efficiency and flexibility of its predecessor. The code and data products are open-source and publicly available.

title: BOLT: Imaging Lightning and Terrestrial Gamma-ray Flashes at the Pierre Auger Observatory
background_knowledge: 地面伽马射线闪（Terrestrial Gamma-ray Flashes, TGFs）是雷暴云内部伴随闪电放电过程产生的极短促、强烈的相对论性高能辐射爆发，其物理起源通常与强电场驱动的相对论性逃逸电子雪崩及随后的轫致辐射有关。皮埃尔·奥格天文台（Pierre Auger Observatory）作为全球规模最大的超高能宇宙线观测装置，其覆盖广阔的地面探测器（Surface Detector）对高能带电粒子和光子高度敏感，因而在日常运行中能捕获到独特的雷电关联信号与罕见的 TGF 事件。研究 TGF 及其母体闪电的协同产生过程，是约束强对流天气中粒子加速物理机制的关键。为了精确探究高能辐射在雷暴中的孕育与演化动力学，天文学与大气物理学界通常借助甚高频（VHF）射电干涉测量阵列，对闪电击穿与前导发展过程开展高时空分辨率的三维成像追踪。
contribution: 本文介绍了针对皮埃尔·奥格天文台开发的**宽带闪电与 TGF 观测站（BOLT）**。该系统是一个干涉测量闪电测绘阵列，利用此前为奥格工程射电阵列（AERA）研制、敏感频段在 $30\text{ MHz} \sim 80\text{ MHz}$ 的甚高频（VHF）射电探测器，实现对**闪电传播过程的高分辨率三维（空间与时间）成像**。BOLT 与天文台地面探测器同址部署，可将**闪电放电活动与候选 TGF 信号直接关联**，从而为限定雷暴中高能辐射的产生机制提供关键观测约束。目前 BOLT 阵列**正处于系统调试阶段**，已成功完成探测站固件升级，**实现了多秒级波形数据的连续采集与传输**。
summary:
Lightning-related phenomena are known to interact with and influence all detector systems of the Pierre Auger Observatory. Notably, the Surface Detector has recorded unique signals associated with Terrestrial Gamma-ray Flashes (TGFs), which are rare phenomena linked to the initial processes of lightning. Studying TGFs in coincidence with their parent lightning discharges helps to constrain the mechanisms responsible for their production, providing key insights into how these high-energy emissions are generated and evolve within thunderstorms.
  To image the parent lightning discharges, we are developing the Broadband Observatory of Lightning and TGFs (BOLT), an interferometric lightning mapping array that enhances the unique capabilities of the Observatory by providing high-resolution 3D (spatial and temporal) imaging of lightning propagation. BOLT consists of VHF radio detectors that have been previously developed for the Auger Engineering Radio Array, sensitive in the 30 MHz to 80 MHz range. The array is co-located with the Surface Detector to enable direct correlation between lightning activity and candidate TGF signals at the Pierre Auger Observatory.
  The BOLT array is in commissioning, with successful station firmware modifications to acquire and stream multi-second waveforms.

title: Changing-look Active Galactic Nuclei from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument. VII. Testing Disk-Corona Diagnostics with eROSITA
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由星系中心的超大质量黑洞吸积驱动。在标准的几何薄、光学厚吸积盘模型中，吸积盘辐射出紫外/光学连续谱，而盘上方的热电子日冕则通过逆康普顿散射将盘光子提升为高能 X 射线。紫外与 X 射线的有效谱指数 $\alpha_{\rm OX}$ 常被用于量化吸积盘与日冕之间的辐射能量分配。近年来，光谱类型发生剧烈转变的“变脸活动星系核”（CL-AGN）引起了广泛关注，其吸积率的变化常被类比于黑洞 X 射线双星（XRB）的态转变；在类比模型中，$\alpha_{\rm OX}$ 与爱丁顿比 $\lambda_{\rm Edd}$ 之间被认为存在特征性的“V 形”轨迹，反映了低吸积率下的辐射低效吸积流（RIAF）与高吸积率下的标准冷盘之间的转换。然而，天体物理中多种光度指标在推导时共享变量，容易引入虚假的数学协方差，因此该 V 形关系究竟代表吸积模式的物理转变，还是统计与光度估算方法引起的假象，仍需严格检验。
contribution: 本研究利用暗能量光谱巡天（DESI）认证的变脸活动星系核（CL-AGN）以及与 eROSITA 全天巡天（eRASS）匹配的对照样本，系统检验了吸积盘-日冕诊断判据。研究发现，$\alpha_{\rm OX}$ 与基于光学连续谱的爱丁顿比 $\lambda_{\rm Edd,opt}$ 之间的正相关**并非 CL-AGN 所独有，在匹配的普通 AGN 中同样存在**。在宽 H$\alpha$ 样本中，这种结构本质上是由**已知 $\alpha_{\rm OX}$ 对紫外光度的依赖关系，以及静止坐标系 2500 Å 光度 $L_{2500}$、黑洞质量 $M_{\rm BH}$ 与 $\lambda_{\rm Edd,opt}$ 之间的内在协方差共同驱动的**。当改用基于 X 射线的爱丁顿比时，两者的相关性完全反转，这表明表观上的 **$\alpha_{\rm OX}$-爱丁顿比“V 形”关系主要是由光度估计方式诱发的假象，不能作为独立的吸积态诊断指标**。此外，eRASS 有效光子指数 $\Gamma_{\rm eff}$ 的分析表明其硬能段趋势依赖于零模型假设且无法单独隔离出日冕软化效应，指明了未来需要借助更深入的 X 射线光谱及独立爱丁顿比测定来探究盘-日冕系统的本质物理演化。
summary: Changing-look active galactic nuclei (CL-AGN) have been proposed to follow an X-ray-binary-like, V-shaped relation between the optical/ultraviolet-to-X-ray spectral slope, $α_{\rm OX}$, and the Eddington ratio, $λ_{\rm Edd}\equiv L_{\rm bol}/L_{\rm Edd}$. We test this interpretation using CL-AGN selected from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) and control samples matched to the eROSITA all-sky survey (eRASS). We find that the apparent positive correlation between $α_{\rm OX}$ and the optical-continuum-based Eddington ratio, $λ_{\rm Edd,opt}$, is not unique to CL-AGN, but also appears in matched non-changing-look samples. In broad-H$α$ AGN, our main statistical sample, this structure is largely driven by the known dependence of $α_{\rm OX}$ on ultraviolet luminosity and by the covariance between the rest-frame 2500 Angstrom luminosity, $L_{2500}$, the black-hole mass, $M_{\rm BH}$, and $λ_{\rm Edd,opt}$. When an X-ray-based Eddington ratio is used instead, the relation reverses sign because the X-ray luminosity, $L_X$, enters the two axes with opposite signs. An apparent $α_{\rm OX}$-Eddington-ratio V-shape can therefore be induced by the luminosity estimator and is not a standalone accretion-state diagnostic. As a complementary test, we examine the eRASS effective photon index, $Γ_{\rm eff}$, inferred from catalogue band fluxes. In broad-line AGN, it shows a weak positive association with the X-ray-independent optical Eddington ratio. However, the weaker hard-band trend depends on the null model and does not isolate coronal softening. These results motivate further X-ray spectroscopy, combined with independently estimated Eddington ratios, to test for intrinsic changes in the disk-corona system.

title: Two Low-Mass-Ratio Microlensing Planets from High-Magnification Events: KMT-2021-BLG-0247 and MOA-2023-BLG-169
background_knowledge: 引力微透镜（Gravitational Microlensing）是基于广义相对论光线偏折效应探测系外行星的独特方法。当作为透镜的天体（恒星及其行星系统）经过远方背景恒星（源星）的视线方向时，其引力场会将源星的光线汇聚放大，形成特征性的光变曲线。高放大率微透镜事件（High-Magnification Events）对低质量比（$q = M_{\rm p}/M_{\rm L}$）的系外行星格外敏感，因为行星会在透镜系统的中心附近激发中央焦散区（Central Caustic），从而在光变曲线峰值处产生显著的畸变。然而，单纯的光变曲线建模通常仅能提供无量纲参数（如质量比和角投影分离），面临严重的参数简并问题。为了准确推导宿主恒星质量、行星质量以及系统距离等物理参数，通常需要测量有限源效应（Finite-Source Effect）以获取角爱因斯坦半径 $\theta_{\rm E}$，并探测微透镜视差效应（Microlens Parallax，$\pi_{\rm E}$），或结合空间望远镜的高分辨率成像以限制透镜与源星的星等和通量。
contribution:
本文对两个具有高放大率和低质量比的行星微透镜事件 KMT-2021-BLG-0247 和 MOA-2023-BLG-169 进行了详细分析，揭示了参数约束程度截然不同的两类物理情境：

1. **KMT-2021-BLG-0247**：该事件中**有限源效应与微透镜视差效应均被清晰探测到**，从而对系统的物理性质施加了罕见的严格约束。解得宿主星质量为 $M_{\rm L} = 0.9 \pm 0.1\,M_\odot$，透镜距离为 $D_{\rm L} = 6.7^{+1.0}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{kpc}$，行星质量确定为 **$M_{\rm p} = 41 \pm 5\,M_\oplus$**（相当于海王星质量级别），宽解与近解对应的投影距离分别为 $a_\perp = 3.4^{+0.7}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{au}$ 和 $3.0^{+0.6}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{au}$。
2. **MOA-2023-BLG-169**：该事件的源星极暗（$I_{S,{\rm OGLE}} = 26.73$），光变曲线允许多个强相关参数解共存。作者通过构建光变曲线参数的近似不变量似然，并引入 Euclid Q2 银河系核球巡天的事件后 Euclid/VIS 空间成像数据（测得对应位置通量为 ${\rm VIS}_{\rm AB} = 23.05 \pm 0.09\,{\rm mag}$）打破简并，最终推导出宿主星质量为 $M_{\rm L} = 0.48^{+0.23}_{-0.17}\,M_\odot$，距离为 $D_{\rm L} = 3.50^{+2.82}_{-1.20}\,\mathrm{kpc}$，投影半长轴为 $a_\perp = 1.62^{+0.77}_{-0.43}\,\mathrm{au}$，行星质量为 **$M_{\rm p} = 143^{+103}_{-63}\,M_\oplus$**（相当于土星质量级别）。
\n该研究表明，**对于极端暗源星事件，微透镜事件时标与角爱因斯坦半径等基础参数仍高度依赖于银河系先验模型和独立的空间高分辨率通量约束**。
summary: We present an analysis of two planetary microlensing events, KMT-2021-BLG-0247 and MOA-2023-BLG-169, both of which exhibit high magnifications and low planet--host mass ratios, but with markedly different levels of parameter constraint. For KMT-2021-BLG-0247, the finite-source effect and microlens parallax are both clearly detected, leading to unusually tight constraints on the physical properties of the lens system. The host mass and lens distance are approximately $M_{\rm L}=0.9\pm0.1\,M_\odot$ and $D_{\rm L}=6.7^{+1.0}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{kpc}$, respectively, and the planet mass is $M_{\rm p}=41\pm5\,M_\oplus$. The projected planet--host separations are $a_\perp=3.4^{+0.7}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{au}$ and $3.0^{+0.6}_{-0.3}\,\mathrm{au}$ for the wide and close solutions, respectively. In contrast, MOA-2023-BLG-169 involves an extremely faint source, with $I_{S,{\rm OGLE}}=26.73$, such that the light curve permits a broad family of strongly correlated solutions. We therefore construct the physical-parameter likelihood using approximate invariant combinations of the light-curve parameters and supplement it with post-event Euclid/VIS imaging from the Euclid Q2 Galactic Bulge Survey (Beaulieu et al. 2026). The Euclid data reveal a component at the event position with ${\rm VIS}_{\rm AB}=23.05\pm0.09\,{\rm mag}$. Interpreting this component as the combined light from the source and any luminous lens, the resulting posterior gives $M_{\rm L}=0.48^{+0.23}_{-0.17}\,M_\odot$, $D_{\rm L}=3.50^{+2.82}_{-1.20}\,\mathrm{kpc}$, $a_\perp=1.62^{+0.77}_{-0.43}\,\mathrm{au}$, and $M_{\rm p}=143^{+103}_{-63}\,M_\oplus$. MOA-2023-BLG-169 demonstrates that, for an extreme faint-source event, even the event timescale and angular Einstein radius can remain strongly dependent on the Galactic prior and independent flux constraints.

title: A Gravitationally Lensed Low-Luminosity AGN From The Cosmic Noon
background_knowledge: 在红移 $z \sim 1 - 3$ 的“宇宙正午”（Cosmic Noon）时期，宇宙中的星系恒星形成率和超大质量黑洞（SMBH）吸积活动均达到峰值。探索这一时期低质量星系中黑洞的吸积与增长，对于理解黑洞早期种子模型的演化路径以及黑洞与宿主星系的共同演化至关重要。然而，受限于现阶段深空 X 射线巡天仪器的灵敏度，宇宙正午时期的低光度活动星系核（Low-Luminosity AGN, LLAGN）本身极其微弱，在不借助外力的情况下极难被直接探测。强引力透镜（Strong Gravitational Lensing）效应利用大质量前景星系团的引力场将背景天体的亮度和尺寸放大数十甚至上百倍，扮演了天然“宇宙望远镜”的角色，使得天文学家能够突破探测极限，深入表征宇宙早期微弱黑洞系统的辐射机制与宿主环境。
contribution: 本研究利用哈勃空间望远镜（HST）成像和钱德拉（Chandra）X 射线观测数据，结合星系团 SDSS J2243$-$0935 的强引力透镜模型，对一个呈现三重成像的极暗 X 射线源进行了系统分析与物理证认。几何透镜模型测得**该源的红移为 $z = 2.14^{+0.12}_{-0.17}$**（与测光红移一致），并测得**总引力放大率高达 $\mu = 78 \pm 7$**。该源在 HST 观测中仅在 F160W 波段探测到，校正透镜效应后的本征星等为 $m_{\rm AB} = 28.2 \pm 0.2$，对应宿主星系的恒星质量为 $8.6 \lesssim \log(M_\star / M_\odot) \lesssim 9.4$，紫外非遮挡恒星形成率上限为 $\mathrm{SFR}_{\rm UV} < 0.009\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$。Chandra 在全部三个透镜图像位置均探测到了 X 射线点源对应体，叠加光谱显示其符合中度吸收幂律辐射（光子指数 $\Gamma \simeq 1.48$，吸收柱密度 $N_{\rm H} = (5.5 \pm 4.4) \times 10^{22}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$），去除透镜放大后得到**静止参考系 $2 - 10\text{ keV}$ 的本征 X 射线光度为 $L_{\rm X} = (1.2 \pm 0.3) \times 10^{42}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$**。这些特征明确证实该 X 射线辐射主要来自中心黑洞吸积，表明该系统是一个**位于宇宙正午、由低质量星系宿主且受强透镜放大的低光度活动星系核（LLAGN）**。
summary: Strong gravitational lensing provides a unique tool of studying intrinsically faint high-redshift active galactic nuclei (AGN). In particular, low-luminosity AGN (LLAGN) can probe black-hole growth in low-mass galaxies that current X-ray surveys cannot otherwise access. We investigate the nature and physical properties of a faint X-ray source triply imaged by the galaxy cluster SDSS J2243$-$0935, and determine whether the source hosts an AGN. We combine archival Hubble Space Telescope imaging and Chandra X-ray observations with the published strong-lensing models of SDSS J2243$-$0935. We constrain the source redshift geometrically, derive magnification maps, and infer the physical properties of the host galaxy. The geometric lensing analysis gives a source redshift of $z=2.14^{+0.12}_{-0.17}$, consistent with the photometric redshift estimate, and a total magnification of $μ=78\pm7$. The source is triply lensed and detected only in the HST F160W band, with an intrinsic magnitude of $m_{\rm AB}=28.2\pm0.2$. The rest-frame optical emission implies a stellar mass of $8.6\lesssim\log(M_\star/M_\odot)\lesssim9.4$. The unobscured star formation rate is constrained to $\mathrm{SFR}_{\rm UV}<0.009\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, although substantial dust obscuration remains possible. Chandra detects X-ray point-source counterparts to all three HST-detected lensed images. The combined X-ray spectrum contains $100\pm11$ net counts and is consistent with a moderately absorbed power law, with $Γ\simeq 1.48$ and $N_{\rm H}=(5.5\pm4.4)\times10^{22}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$. After correcting for gravitational magnification, we obtain an intrinsic rest-frame $2$--$10$ keV luminosity of $L_{\rm X}=1.2\pm0.3\times10^{42}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$. The X-ray emission is likely dominated by an AGN hosted by a low-mass galaxy at $z\simeq2.14$, making this system a strongly lensed LLAGN at cosmic noon (abridged).

title: Effective Neutrino Mass and Apparent Phantom Crossing
background_knowledge: 中微子振荡实验确立了中微子具有非零质量差，基于正常质量排序（Normal Ordering）推导出的中微子质量和存在一个理论下限（约为 $0.06\text{ eV}$）。在宇宙学中，大尺度结构形成与宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）对相对论性中微子的自由流（Free-streaming）效应极为敏感，因此能够从宏观上对中微子质量和施加严格约束。然而，近年来结合普朗克卫星、重子声学振荡（BAO）等观测给出的宇宙学上限越来越紧，甚至在部分模型分析中低于粒子物理实验给出的下限，形成了潜在的观测张力。此外，以近期暗能量光谱巡天（DESI）为代表的最新观测结果提示晚期宇宙暗能量可能具有动力学演化特征，甚至暗示暗能量状态方程跨越了 $w = -1$ 的“幽灵分界”（Phantom Divide）。在传统场论中，正则标量场（如精质场）无法在不破坏零能量条件或引发鬼态不稳定的情况下实现幽灵跨越，这驱使理论学者探索中微子与暗能量标量场耦合的质量可变中微子（MaVaN）等扩展模型。
contribution: 本研究基于质量可变中微子（MaVaN）宇宙学模型，探讨了由正则赝南布-金石玻色子（pNGB）驱动晚期宇宙加速膨胀并通过指数耦合调控中微子质量的物理机制。结合最新的 CMB、BAO 与 Ia 型超新星数据，作者重构了中微子质量的演化历史，**证明了宇宙学推断的有效中微子质量可以低于现今正常排序的理论下限，同时在粒子物理层面与地面振荡实验保持自洽，从而有效缓解了中微子质量张力**。此外，该耦合相互作用在晚期宇宙留下了独特的观测印记：**后验膨胀历史中有 96% 显示出表观幽灵跨越行为，在 $68\%$ 置信度下表观暗能量状态方程在红移 $z_{\rm cross} = 0.90^{+0.28}_{-0.13}$ 处跨越 $w_{\rm app} = -1$**。**底层的标量场本身始终保持正则态（$w_\phi \ge -1$）**，表明该机制无需引入非物理的幽灵场或破坏零能量条件，即可同时解释当前观测所倾向的幽灵跨越信号并化解中微子质量异常。
summary: Recent cosmological constraints on the sum of neutrino masses have reached, and in some analyses fallen below, the minimum value implied by the normal mass ordering, suggesting a possible tension with neutrino-oscillation measurements. We investigate whether this discrepancy can be alleviated in a mass-varying-neutrino (MaVaN) cosmology in which a canonical pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone boson (pNGB) drives late-time cosmic acceleration and controls the masses of massive neutrinos through an exponential coupling. Using current cosmic microwave background, baryon acoustic oscillation, and type Ia supernova data, we reconstruct the neutrino-mass evolution and show that the cosmologically inferred effective neutrino mass can fall below the present-day normal-ordering floor while remaining consistent with oscillation constraints. The same interaction produces a distinctive late-time signature, with 96% of the posterior expansion histories exhibiting a crossing of the apparent phantom divide, $w_{\rm app}=-1$, at $z_{\rm cross}=0.90^{+0.28}_{-0.13}$ at 68% C.L. The underlying scalar field nevertheless remains canonical, with $w_φ\geq -1$. Our results therefore show that neutrino mass variation can simultaneously alleviate the apparent neutrino-mass tension and generate the phantom-crossing behavior favored by current cosmological data, without introducing a phantom field or violating the null energy condition.

title: MUSE-ALMA Haloes XVI: a census of the condensed baryons in z~0.5 HI absorption-selected galaxies
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化框架中，重子物质在星系际介质、星系周介质（CGM）以及星际介质（ISM）之间的循环流动是驱动恒星形成的关键物理机制。重子通过吸积冷气体注入星系内部，在引力坍缩下形成中性原子氢（H I）与分子气体（$\text{H}_2$），进而坍缩形成恒星；恒星风与超新星爆发等反馈过程又会将金属和气体抛射回 CGM 中。由于弥散的冷气体发射极为微弱，观测上常利用背景类星体视线方向上的强 Ly$\alpha$ 吸收线（如阻尼 Ly$\alpha$ 系统）作为高灵敏度探针，结合多波段空间望远镜与大型地面望远镜（如 HST、VLT/MUSE、ALMA 等），联合测量吸收体附近星系的恒星成分、电离气体运动学以及冷分子气体含量，从而对宇宙中间红移时期的重子预算与多相气体转化机制建立全面的统计普查。
contribution:
本研究利用 MUSE-ALMA Haloes 巡天样本，对 $0.2 < z < 1.2$ 范围内、靠近强 H I Ly$\alpha$ 吸收体（投影距离约为 $5 - 270\text{ kpc}$ 且径向视向速度差在 $500\text{ km/s}$ 以内）的 79 个富气体星系开展了凝聚态重子（恒星与冷气体）普查，结合 HST、MUSE 和 ALMA 多相示踪观测，获得了以下主要发现：
1. **H I 质量估算的一致性**：在投影撞击参数 $< 100\text{ kpc}$ 范围内，由星系光学性质推断的 H I 质量与由 CGM 吸收体性质估算的质量**呈现出广泛的一致性**，但致密或群组环境会对该估算产生显著影响。
2. **冷气体比例的标度行为**：分子气体比例随恒星质量的下降斜率比 H I 比例**更加陡峭**。这表明星系内恒星质量的积累速度快于冷气体库的补给，且大质量星系具有更高的分子气体消耗效率，或将 H I 转化为 $\text{H}_2$ 的转化效率更低。
3. **重子比例与恒星面密度关联**：高恒星面密度星系表现出**最高的重子比例**。该现象可能归因于重子反馈使致密系统的内区暗物质轮廓变平缓，或是孔径效应导致（致密源的电离气体示踪范围仅局限于重子主导的核心区，而延展源则延伸至暗物质晕深处）。
4. **宇宙学演化承接关系**：样本中少数星系被证实与 JWST 探测到的 $z \sim 6$ 低质量星系所演化出的**重子主导后代相符合**，但多数星系表现为暗物质主导的更低质量系统，其早期祖先超出了目前 JWST 的探测灵敏度极限。
summary: We use the MUSE-ALMA Haloes sample to build a census of the condensed baryons (stars and cold gas) to study the multiphase interstellar medium and circumgalactic medium (CGM). The sample includes 79 gas-rich galaxies at 0.2<z<1.2 located near strong HI Ly-alpha absorbers along quasar sightlines within projected separations of ~5-270 kpc and radial velocity separations of up to 500 km/s. HST spectroscopy characterises the absorbers, while HST imaging, MUSE and ALMA observations trace the stars, ionised gas and molecular gas. We find the following results. (i) HI masses inferred from optical properties show broad agreement with those derived from the CGM absorber properties for impact parameters <100 kpc, although group environments can significantly influence these estimates. (ii) The molecular gas fraction declines more steeply with stellar mass than the HI fraction. This suggests that stars build up more rapidly than the cold gas reservoir, while massive galaxies either consume their molecular gas more efficiently or convert HI into H2 less efficiently. (iii) Galaxies with high stellar surface densities exhibit the highest baryon fractions. This may reflect baryonic feedback, which can produce flatter inner dark matter profiles in high surface density systems, or aperture effects, where the ionised gas kinematic tracer probes only the innermost, baryon-dominated regions in compact sources, but extends further into the dark matter halo in sources with extended baryonic distributions. (iv) A few galaxies are consistent with being the baryon-dominated descendants of the low mass z~6 galaxies detected by JWST, while many appear to be substantially more dark matter dominated, lower mass systems with progenitors beyond JWST detection limits. This study provides a multiscale, multiphase view of the gas in and around galaxies, allowing us to probe the baryon budget across cosmic time.

title: Phenomenology of axion-meson mixing and scattering processes
background_knowledge: 轴子（Axion）最初作为解决量子色动力学（QCD）中强 CP 问题的佩奇-奎因（Peccei-Quinn）机制所预言的伪标量粒子被提出，而类轴子粒子（Axion-like Particle, ALP）则是广泛存在于弦论及高能唯象理论中的推广预言。由于质量极轻且与标准模型粒子耦合微弱，ALP 是当今天文学和粒子物理学中最具竞争力的暗物质候选体之一。在 QCD 手征对称性自发破缺尺度以下的低能有效场论框架中，ALP 会与标准模型中的轻赝标介子（如 $ \pi^0 $、$\eta $、$\eta' $）发生动能和质量混合。手征微扰理论（Chiral Perturbation Theory, $\chi\text{PT}$）是系统研究此类强相互作用低能极限的核心理论工具，精确求解介子与 ALP 的相互作用不仅对于理解极早期宇宙暗物质的产生至关重要，也为地面高精度对撞机、介子稀有衰变实验以及天体物理中的暗物质探测提供了坚实的理论基准。
contribution: 本研究基于手征微扰理论（$\chi\text{PT}$），系统研究了广义 ALP 与轻赝标介子之间的混合效应及其对低能散射和衰变过程的影响。作者从最普遍的 ALP 有效拉格朗日量出发，在 ALP 衰变常数与同位旋对称性破缺的主阶近似下，推导了适用于任意 ALP 质量的 **ALP-介子动能与质量混合**，并计算了精确至 $ \mathcal{O}(F^2/f_a^2) $ 的物理 ALP 质量，**成功重现了 QCD 轴子极限，并揭示了裸质量为零的 ALP 将共享 QCD 轴子物理质量**的规律。此外，研究构建了一套适用于包含赝标介子和任意数量 ALP 的所有四体散射振幅的紧凑参数化形式，并以 $ K\bar{K} \to P^0a $ 散射过程进行了实例展示。该框架自洽地**纳入了对禁戒跃迁至关重要的同位旋破缺效应**，且完全适用于通用的 ALP 质量与耦合参数空间。
summary: We study the mixing between a generic axion-like particle (ALP) and the light pseudoscalar mesons within chiral perturbation theory ($χ$PT), and its consequences for low-energy scattering and decay processes. Starting from the most general ALP effective Lagrangian, we derive the ALP-meson kinetic and mass mixing induced at leading order in the ALP decay constant and isospin breaking for arbitrary ALP masses. As a result, we obtain the physical ALP mass to $\mathcal{O}(F^2/f_a^2)$, recovering the QCD-axion limit and finding that any ALP with a vanishing bare mass shares the QCD-axion mass. We provide a compact parameterization of every four-body amplitude involving pseudoscalar mesons and an arbitrary number of ALPs. As an illustration, we show the $K\bar{K}\to P^0a$ scattering. The framework applies for general ALP masses and couplings and consistently incorporates isospin breaking, essential for otherwise forbidden processes.

title: On the origin of the short-period Blue Straggler Stars in Collinder 261: a binary evolution approach
background_knowledge: 蓝离散星（Blue Straggler Stars, 简称 BSS）是星团色-星等图上一类反常的恒星群体，其位置位于主序拐点之上，表现出比同星团其他主序星更高的光度与表面温度。按照标准单星恒星演化理论，同星团恒星具有相近的年龄与初始化学成分，质量大于拐点质量的恒星应早已演化为红巨星或致密天体，因而蓝离散星的存在是恒星演化研究中的重要反例。目前公认的蓝离散星形成通道主要包括密近双星系统的物质转移（Mass Transfer）或直接并合（Merger），以及致密星团环境中的恒星动力学碰撞。疏散星团中恒星数密度相对球状星团较低，动力学碰撞率极低，因此是检验双星演化成因的理想天然实验室。借助 Gaia 等高精度测光与天体测量巡天，结合对食双星、椭球变星及脉动变星（如 SX Phe 型变星）的短周期光变监测与双星演化数值模拟，天文学家得以精确回溯蓝离散星的前身星物理参数及其演化路径。
contribution: 本文利用 Gaia DR3 银河系疏散星团蓝离散星最新编目，对古老疏散星团 Collinder 261 中具有短周期测光变异特性的蓝离散星（包含 9 颗食双星/椭球双星和 5 颗 SX Phe 脉动变星候选体）进行了系统研究。作者首先精确测定了变星的测光周期并对变异类型进行了分类，随后基于两颗子星的恒星结构演化、轨道演化及物质转移率开展了精细的双星演化数值模拟，并求解恒星大气结构以合成未分辨双星系统在 Gaia DR3 测光通带下的组合色-星等轨迹。通过对初始质量、初始轨道周期以及物质转移效率等参数空间的网格探测，研究发现**双星演化（物质转移机制）完全能够合理解释 Collinder 261 中这类短周期食双星蓝离散星的形成**，且**物质转移效率在精确匹配色-星等图上较暗弱蓝离散星样本的观测特征中起到了决定性作用**。
summary: Building on the recent publication of a fresh catalog of blue straggler stars in Galactic open clusters using Gaia DR3, we conduct a study focusing on the blue straggler stars with short-period photometric variability found in the open cluster Collinder 261: nine eclipsing or ellipsoidal binaries and five SX Phe pulsator candidates. Our investigation delves into the potential of mass transfer in binary systems to account for the presence and properties of these stars. We first measure their photometric periods and classify the variables into eclipsing/ellipsoidal binaries, SX Phe pulsator candidates, and instrumental aliases or blends. Subsequently, we perform a set of simulations based on comprehensive calculations of the structure of both stars within the binary system, as well as their orbital evolution and mass transfer rates. To compare with observations, we solved the atmospheric structure of each stellar component and computed filter-weighted integrated fluxes in the Gaia DR3 passbands, obtaining a combined evolutionary sequence that accounts for the unresolved flux of both stars as seen photometrically. Our investigation includes the study of several parameters, such as the initial mass of both stars, the initial orbital period, and the efficiency of mass transfer. The aim is to identify potential progenitor candidates matching color-magnitude diagram observations at the same age as that determined for Collinder 261. We find that binary evolution serves as a viable mechanism for producing these eclipsing blue stragglers and that the efficiency of mass transfer plays a key role in accurately matching the fainter objects.

title: Complex Organic Molecules in Protostars with ALMA Spectral Surveys (COMPASS) V. Tracing cavity walls and shocked knots with nonthermally desorbed CH$_3$OH in BHR71-IRS1
background_knowledge: 在低质量恒星形成的早期演化阶段，富含复杂有机分子（Complex Organic Molecules, COMs）的星周气体扮演着揭示化学演化历程的关键角色。传统图像认为，COMs 主要在极冷环境下星际尘埃颗粒的冰幔表面通过表面反应合成；当原恒星形成并加热周围介质至约 $100\text{ K}$ 以上时，这些分子通过热解吸（thermal desorption）释放到气相中，形成高温且致密的“热日冕”（hot corino）。然而，越来越多的观测在远离中央恒星的冷区、外流空腔壁以及激波区域也探测到了气相 COMs，这表明存在由紫外光解吸、化学反应解吸（reactive desorption）或激波诱导的尘埃溅射（sputtering）等驱动的非热解吸机制。解析不同微观环境下的非热解吸过程，对于厘清星际有机分子究竟是直接遗传至原行星盘乃至行星系统，还是在吸积塌缩过程中经历了化学重置（chemical reset），具有基础性的物理意义。
contribution: 本研究利用阿塔卡马大型毫米波/亚毫米波阵列（ALMA）的大型巡天项目 COMPASS，针对低质量原恒星 BHR71-IRS1 热日冕外部的扩展 $\mathrm{CH_3OH}$（甲醇）辐射展开了细致研究。团队结合主成分分析（PCA）与局部热力学平衡（LTE）假设下的转动图及光谱建模分析，**总计证认出 26 条扩展 $\mathrm{CH_3OH}$ 谱线**，并揭示了三种典型空间分布结构：**X 形外流空腔壁、南北向激波结，以及东部/东南部成分**。分析表明，**空腔壁具有较低的激发温度（$ \sim 25\text{ K} $）和约为 $ 10^{14}\text{ cm}^{-2} $ 的柱密度，结合较窄的线宽特征，支持该区域的甲醇释放主要源自原恒星远紫外（FUV）辐射驱动的反应性解吸机制**；而**激波结则表现出较高的激发温度（$ 70 - 120\text{ K} $）以及显著更高的柱密度（$ 10^{14} - 10^{16}\text{ cm}^{-2} $），强力支持由 C 型激波引起的尘埃溅射解吸图像**。该成果明确了不同动力学与辐射环境下主导的非热解吸机制，为追踪恒星形成早期的有机分子演化提供了关键观测证据。
summary: Complex organic molecules are detected in both cold molecular clouds and the warm inner regions of protostars. Whether they are eventually inherited by protostars and planets or whether their chemistry is reset by in situ reactions remains unclear. Understanding the desorption mechanisms of these molecules is essential for tracing their chemical evolution. As part of the ALMA Large Program Complex Organic Molecules in Protostars with ALMA Spectral Surveys (COMPASS), we investigate the CH$_3$OH emission that extends beyond the hot corino of BHR71-IRS1. We identified extended CH$_3$OH emission around BHR71-IRS1. We assessed characteristic emission structures by applying a principal component analysis. The physical properties of their line-emitting gas were derived under the local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) assumption through both rotational diagram and spectral modeling analyses. In total, 26 extended CH$_3$OH lines have been detected. These emission lines are distributed across (1) X-shaped cavity walls, (2) northern and southern shocked knots, and (3) eastern and southeastern components. The cavity walls exhibit excitation temperatures of $\sim$ 25~K and column densities of $\sim$ 10$^{14}$~cm$^{-2}$, while the knots show relatively higher excitation temperatures (70$-$120~K) and column densities ($10^{14}-10^{16}$~cm$^{-2}$). The physical properties of eastern and southeastern components are not well constrained under LTE conditions. Plausible desorption mechanisms are evaluated by comparing the physical parameters with model predictions. The low excitation temperatures and narrow line widths in the cavity walls favor a reactive desorption scenario driven by far-ultraviolet irradiation from IRS1. In contrast, the knots with higher excitation temperatures and column densities support the dust sputtering scenario induced by C-type shocks.

title: An early $Z'$ dominance: dark matter, gravitational waves & collider probes
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学模型中，大爆炸核合成（BBN）之前的极早期宇宙通常被假定为处于辐射主导时期。然而，在现有观测边界之外（即温度高于数个 $\mathrm{MeV}$ 的时期），宇宙完全可能经历非标准的宇宙学历史，例如由某种长寿命粒子主导的早期物质主导（EMD）时期。在粒子物理标准模型（SM）的诸多扩展方案中，引入规范 $B-L$（重子数减轻子数）阿贝尔对称性的模型具有极高吸引力；该模型为了消除规范反常，自然引入了三个右手中微子，既可通过跷跷板机制解释微小的中微子质量，又能提供潜在的暗物质候选者。此外，当规范 $B-L$ 对称性自发破缺时，拓扑缺陷——宇宙弦（cosmic strings）随之产生，其演化和衰变会产生跨越宽频带的原初随机引力波背景。将粒子物理唯象学、早期宇宙非标准膨胀历史与多信使天文观测（如引力波与高能中微子）相结合，是检验新物理模型的重要范式。
contribution: 本文在最小无反常规范 $B-L$ 扩展模型框架下，研究了新阿贝尔规范玻色子 $Z'$ 在 BBN 之前主导宇宙能量密度、从而诱发**早期物质主导（EMD）时期**的物理演化图像。研究将三个右手中微子之一视作衰变型暗物质候选者，计算了其在该 EMD 阶段的产生机制，并证明满足暗物质剩余丰度的参数空间恰好位于**多个未来引力波探测实验的预期灵敏度区间内**（引力波信号源自 $B-L$ 对称性破缺产生的宇宙弦）。此外，文章系统结合了对撞机实验、束流收集实验、BBN 以及超高能中微子观测的现有约束，完整刻画了模型的存活参数空间，**展示了多信使协同探测在探索超出标准模型物理与 BBN 之前非标准宇宙学演化历史中的强大互补性**。
summary: In the minimal anomaly-free gauged B$-$L extension of the Standard Model (SM), we consider a scenario in which the energy density of the new Abelian gauge boson dominates the Universe prior to big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN), resulting in an early matter-dominated (EMD) era. Taking one of the three right-handed neutrinos to be a decaying dark matter (DM) candidate, we investigate its production during this EMD phase. We show that the region of parameter space consistent with the relic abundance lies within the projected sensitivity of several gravitational wave (GW) experiments, where the GW signal arises from cosmic strings formed during the spontaneous breaking of the gauged B$-$L symmetry. We further constrain the viable parameter space using bounds from collider experiments, beam dump experiments, BBN, and ultra high energy neutrino observations, demonstrating the complementarity of multi-messenger probes in exploring physics beyond the SM as well as non-standard cosmological histories prior to BBN.
